stories.title: 5 CCSD schools may close in $3.7B district-wide campus plan, officials say
stories.summary: Five Clark County School District elementary schools may close, and a sixth relocated, under a multibillion-dollar facility plan that spans the next several school years, according to district officials.

stories.title: Jack Bech’s stock soars based on connection with Raiders QB Fernando Mendoza
stories.summary: Jack Bech, the second-year receiver, has the two most targeted games of his career since Fernando Mendoza took over as starting quarterback of the Raiders.

stories.title: Attorney argues AI ‘compromised’ prior effort to dismiss Piero’s bombing suspect’s case
stories.summary: A defense lawyer argued that the suspect’s prior attorney was defending himself against allegations of improper AI use while also trying to get the case dismissed.

stories.title: ‘Poor timing’: Storm could cause chaos for Macy’s parade in New York
stories.summary: Heavy rain and high winds are expected to start Wednesday night along the coast of the Carolinas, hit the New York City area on Thanksgiving Day and reach Maine by Friday.

stories.title: Las Vegas softball player kicked off team after video of her punching opponent goes viral
stories.summary: A Las Vegas-based travel softball organization dismissed a 16-and-under player after she repeatedly punched an opponent at a tournament in Southern California.

stories.title: Las Vegas Thrill select Penn State’s Whitney Lauenstein with No. 2 pick
stories.summary: The Las Vegas Thrill selected Penn State outside hitter Whitney Lauenstein with the franchise’s first-round pick in the 2026 MLV Draft on Monday afternoon.

stories.title: Message to UNR football: Beware of UNLV in fourth quarter
stories.summary: The Rebels have been nails entering the final 15 minutes of games, going 33-2 when leading entering the fourth quarter since 2023.

stories.title: Klint Kubiak sees improvement in Fernando Mendoza after 2 starts for Raiders
stories.summary: Fernando Mendoza might not have a win on his ledger as an NFL starting quarterback yet, but he’s trending closer based on Sunday’s showing — flashing his No. 1 draft pick talent.

stories.title: College basketball betting: All signs point to Tennessee for Players Era 16 title
stories.summary: There are several legitimate national title contenders in this field, but Tennessee offers the best value among the tournament futures.

stories.title: Henderson hotel-casino unveils new arrival experience in $87M renovation
stories.summary: Sunset Station opened the all-new Sunset Bar on Monday, unveiling the hotel’s new lobby lounge and centerpiece of a comprehensive redesign of the property’s arrival encounter.

stories.title: College football betting: Bid adieu to midweek football as MACtion ends
stories.summary: That streak ends next Tuesday because this is the final week of the college football regular season, so we’ll bid adieu to midweek MAC games until next October.
